summary_en: The EF zkEVM team published its 2026 L1-zkEVM roadmap with milestones for bringing zkEVM proofs into the core protocol. ACDT #67: EIP-7888 dropped its receipt field and bal-devnet-2 slipped to next week. ERC-8004 was updated from community feedback and merged. zksecurityXYZ formalized FRI soundness in Lean.
